L23: COMMENTS
L24: Number of compositions [c(1), c(2), c(3), ...] of n such that either c(k) = c(k-1) + 1 or c(k) = 1; see example. Same as fountains of coins (cite11†A005169 ) where each valley is at the lowest level. - cite12†Joerg Arndt , Mar 25 2014

L35: G.f. : 1 / (1 - Sum_{k>=1} x^(k*(k+1)/2) ).

L38: a(n) = a(n-1) + a(n-3) + a(n-6) + a(n-10) + ... cite18†Gregory L. Simay , Jun 09 2016
